text:
sarah: quick follow-up on ingress adaptive hints + resumable-trailer idea. goal: cheap admit hint header, aggregate metrics, and an opt-in resume trailer for routes that want checkpointing.

alex: ok. two hot questions: perf impact on dispatch hotpath and multi-tenant leakage.

sarah: perf: single atomic read of queue depth at dispatch, build tiny header string; gated by global flag + per-route visibility. privacy: header numeric-only, e.g. `X-Edge-Admit: lvl=2;q=39;win=5` (no tenant ids).

jamie: define lvl semantics? clients need to know whether to back off or expect rejects.

sarah: proposal: lvl=0 healthy, 1 advisory (batching hint), 2 constrained (prefer client backoff/retry), 3 shed (gateway may reject non-priority). SDK guidance: ignore lvl=1; act on lvl>=2.

mike: streaming: if we checkpoint mid-stream, trailer format, token shape, and billing semantics?

sarah: trailer opt-in per-route. emit `Edge-Resume: tok=base64url...;off=1536;lvl=3;exp=300`. tok contains model-version digest + window id + HMAC. billing: resumed calls billed only for newly generated tokens after resume; checkpoint metadata TTL default 5m; model rollouts invalidate older tokens; single-use nonces optional per-route.

alex: token size cap ~64 bytes, include expiry and hmac. clients should verify model-version prefix to avoid replay across rollouts.

jamie: observability: avoid trace spam. plan: aggregate histograms (queue depth, admit latency) scraped every 10s; sample traces at admit time when lvl>=2 or when resume emitted; tag samples with `pressure_lvl` and `admit_bucket`. dashboards: "Ingress admit heatmap"; alert if sustained lvl>=2 >60s.

mike: retry storms when clients aggressively retry on 5xx/429. can we provide backoff hints?

sarah: header is advisory first. if enforcement needed, return 429 + `Retry-After` and include `Edge-Backoff: base=250;jitter=0.25;mode=exp` as a respectful hint.

alex: bench plan: microbench hotpath with header on/off (p50/p99 and CPU), plus canary rollout controls. need tenant opt-out for dedicated/private clusters.

sarah: feature flags: `edge.admit_hints.enabled` global and `route.admit.visibility` per-route/tenant. dedicated clusters can set global flag false. i'll add bench tasks to RFC.

jamie: sampling bias: sample at admit-time not completion-time so we don't overrepresent long requests. include admit-bucket for joinability.

sarah: agreed. will sample at admit, attach snapshot tags.

ops-bot: RFC-1784 staged to edge-canary-5  canary window 02:00 UTC, 10% traffic.

mike: one last: define token validation steps in doc and a compact migration path for invalidation on model deploy.

sarah: will add token spec (format, hmac, expiry, single-use option) + migration/invalidation notes in RFC branch tonight. alex will run microbench, jamie drafts dashboards, mike reviews crypto. thanks all :thumbsup:
